_about: Real ways a Sahelian farmer or extension agent asks about each verified fact in sahel_reference.json. These drive training rows (training/reference_qa.py) so the weights and the embedded reference block teach the SAME answer — a model trained to contradict its own system prompt is worse than one trained on neither. Phrasings are deliberately uneven in register: some are typed carefully, some are terse and lowercase, because that is what a chat box receives.
